status_definitions.VERIFIED: Shown in a public PDF preview page image, or confirmed by 2+ separately authored public landing sections.
status_definitions.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: Found in only one public place (the landing page's data), no preview page shows it.
status_definitions.CONFLICTING: Two public places disagree. Both values are kept in conflicting_values/note.
status_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: Not publicly exposed. value is null and unavailable_reason says why.
